description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hiththatiya Meda, Matara D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820003 (22/0773)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of specific land parcels, their owners, extents, encumbrances, and legal status. The content is focused on land ownership and property rights matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements for specific parcels of land.
